title: Vested' Tornado
description: A plugin that adds in a server-side tornado to your server
body:
![A picture of the tornado mod](https://ideal-perch-489.convex.cloud/api/storage/48bfd6f1-9055-4584-8cc7-07a92c84c2e3)

**Vested' Tornado** is a highly configurable **server-side Minecraft plugin** with features like a tornado into Minecraft.

# 📥**Installation**
It has only ever been tested in Paper servers and will be coming to other plugin supported servers in the near future.

# 🐛Report Bugs
I don't have a official way of reporting bugs to me. I'm sorry
